messages:
Kamal: Quick note from today's canary: escrow handshake spikes caused resident-write flapping between eu and na. Proposal: lightweight "handshake-policy" with three outcomes: immediate-failover, hold-and-shadow, or anonymize-and-serve.

Rhea: +1 on policy. Must be per-tenant and observable. We can't let a legal flag silently stop failover.

Owen: For correctness, add a short-lived lock on tenant-key during handshake to avoid double-apply when two regions accept writes. If lock unavailable => return 429 and client retries.

Priya: Operator ops: need console view for locked keys and handshake latencies. Also alert if handshake queue > threshold for > 5m.

Kamal: Default timeouts suggestion: handshake_fast=3s, handshake_grace=20s. Make per-tenant override allowed.

Rhea: How about record formats? Dataplane should attach X-Consent-Mode and X-Shadow-Id headers; shadow objects must be encrypted and TTL'd.

Owen: Reconciliation: POST /v1/tenants/{t}/shadows/{id}/commit with signed commit_token validated via KMS. Reconcile job emits cache invalidation.

Priya: Legal note: anonymize fallback requires explicit tenant opt-in in some regions. We'll tag tenants accordingly and block anonymize unless enabled.

henry-bot: Canary run summary uploaded: 2 high-latency handshakes, 1 shadow leak (orphaned) observed. See CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/ran/12345

Kamal: Action items: Owen to prototype lock + commit flow (EOW), Rhea to add telemetry + console mocks (Mon), Priya to coordinate legal gating (Tue). If no objections react :thumbsup:.

Rhea: :thumbsup:
Owen: :thumbsup:
Priya: :neutral_face: (needs legal doc)

Kamal: noted, will add legal doc to RFC. Closing thread for now.
